Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001] — some quick background on J\_DISP\_LED:

Because the e-paper doesn't include its own light, we're placing an external LED behind it to provide backlighting. The final LED hasn't been selected yet; I'm first testing a 5V COB strip and may later change to a 3.3V frontlight module, so the design must support either option.

For this build, please populate:
\- BSS138 as the low-side switch, with GPIO42 PWM controlling brightness
\- 10kΩ gate resistor and 10kΩ gate pull-down, so the LED remains off while booting
\- The 5V jumper on Pin 1, while leaving the 3V3 jumper footprint unpopulated
\- A 4.7µF X5R 0603 cap between Pin 1 and GND for PWM ripple decoupling
\- Keep the series resistor footprint DNP because the LED strip limits itself
\- Do not add a flyback diode, since the LED is resistive rather than inductive

At worst, the current will be ~70mA, based on a 5W/m strip × 67mm cut, which is comfortably below the BSS138's 200mA rating.

The 3V3 jumper and DNP series R footprint are included solely as a fallback for a possible future bare-LED configuration; leaving both empty now adds no cost.

The complete specification is in [URL_016], within the J\_DISP\_LED rows / pinout / Critical Routing.
